What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[Baze Malbus With Cannon]]: left, the image of [[Baze Malbus With Cannon]] (holotable commit 022435b); right, the image of [[Baze Malbus With Cannon (Errata)]] (holotable commit a57375e). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/bazemalbuswithcannon.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a57375eaf483d0e05592c08185b77505a415f0e5/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/bazemalbuswithcannon.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
